overview: All three of David Baddiel's universally critically acclaimed one-man shows will land on Sky Arts & NOW in November. These first original stand-up commissions for Sky Arts will see My Family: Not the Sitcom premiere on Saturday 9 November, Fame: Not the Musical on 16 November and Trolls: Not the Dolls following on 23 November, all at 10pm on Sky Arts and available on NOW. Taped at London's iconic Royal Court Theatre earlier this year, David reprised the three critically acclaimed shows which saw him return to stand up (after 15 years away) and perform in the UK and internationally from 2013 - 2021.
title: David Baddiel - The Not The Trilogy

overview: A border town cop uncovers an illegal drug trade tied to his childhood friend and a ruthless British crime syndicate operating in the scenic 1000 Islands region between Canada and the U.S.
title: The Borderline

overview: Through unparalleled access, The Stanford Prison Experiment: Unlocking the Truth embarks on a gripping, ticking-clock journey through the six-day Stanford Prison Experiment with a deluge of reveals, new subjects and a smoking-gun archive. The docuseries weaves together shocking, poignant and sometimes humorous firsthand accounts from the very participants who were at the heart of the experiment. Then, in an unexpected turn, the series brings the participants to a replica film set of the "prison," where they revisit pivotal moments and attempt to find consensus — and closure — about what really happened over the course of those six days.
title: The Stanford Prison Experiment: Unlocking the Truth

overview: What Not To Do With Dad sees TikTok star and party-animal, Ash Holme take on the types of challenges you would never, EVER want your parent to know about. Only she's taking her dad, Phil, along for the ride.... How will they fare learning to pole dance? Visiting a sex club? Or double dating? And what will they discover about each other - and their relationship - in the process?
title: Ash Holme: What Not To Do With Dad

overview: Teenage outcast Luna has difficulties fitting in at school. A loner, she is bullied and feels despised for being ‘ugly' and ‘poor'. She really wants everyone to like her - or at least Jake, whom she has a crush on. A freak accident one day forces her down an unexpected path through alternate realities in search of happiness, only to face dreadful consequences.
title: Alienated

overview: This definitive docuseries chronicles the Red Sox's journey to their first World Series title in 86 years via interviews with star players and personnel.
title: The Comeback: 2004 Boston Red Sox

overview: "Naydi po ID" is a real Internet investigation using the latest technology. Can you trust a distant relative who has reconnected with you after a long break? What to do if you have fallen in love with an online acquaintance, but she does not want to see you? Where to go if someone has stolen your candid photos and threatens to post them on the Internet? The host Nikolai Leibov has one answer to these and other questions - to figure out the secret ill-wisher and find out what the interlocutor on the other side of the screen is really up to.
title: Найди по ID

overview: RAP:PUBLIC invites you to a hip-hop survival world you have never seen before. It's a real hip-hop survival show where the participants compete and survive using rap as their weapon. The rappers form their own 'blocks' and compete as a team to survive in a society disconnected from the outside world. In this society where cooperation and competition coexist, they can only decide their fate through games that use rap. The final winning block will be given 300,000 dollars as a prize and become the first owner of RAP:PUBLIC.
title: Rap:Public

overview: iQIYI's first original talent show a global male idol audition! Here, dazzling teenagers from all over the world gather to receive professional training at Starlight Academy, crossing the boundaries of language and culture, and igniting the stage with their talent and passion. Through fierce competition and teamwork, they will compete for the opportunity to become a globally recognized super idol. Let's witness how they are born from the starlight and become trendsetting stars!
title: Starlight Boys

overview: The documentary series KOKO, about the Olympic, World and European champion athlete, presents the life of István Kovács Kokó in four parts. The still popular boxer tells the story of the highs and lows of his life and sporting career. You will meet the people who were influential in his life and hear from legends such as Imre Szántó (Uncle Öcsi), Dariusz Michalczewski and Vitalij Klicsko.
title: KOKO

overview: TV2 Secrets with Ramóna is an exciting and unique podcast featuring in-depth interviews with famous people. We reveal the aspects and stories that remain hidden from the public eye. The show uncovers the reality behind the people, exploring the challenges, successes, failures, and moments that have shaped their lives. Each episode is an exciting journey behind the fame, helping us better understand and appreciate the individuals who have become part of our lives. Here, the curtain truly falls on everything! It's not just about asking questions; we have real conversations! – Hosted by Ramóna Kiss.
title: TV2 Titkok Ramónával

overview: Stage Fighter is a survival program in which male dancers from ballet, contemporary dance, and Korean traditional dance genres will compete against each other in a ranked battle. The dancers will combine their unique dance styles with modern and popular dance elements to present spectacular group performances.
title: Stage Fighter

overview: A fast-paced action-thriller about the Finnish Security Intelligence Service detective Arto Ratamo who is assigned a very delicate case that threatens the national security of Finland. The investigation gets complicated as it seems that the Prime Minister of Finland is either being blackmailed by a Russian oligarch - or has he leaked the classified information himself?
title: Ratamo

overview: Morgen hör ich auf is a drama in which Bastian Pastewka plays Jochen Lehmann. He is married, father of three and owner of an almost bankrupt printing company. Both professionally and personally it doesn't go well for Jochen. He also has financial issues. The bank doesn't want to give him more credit and his wife Julia (Susanne Wolff) has a lover. And just when things do downwards for Jochen he begins to print fake banknotes. Although the counterfeited bills dissolve the worst financial problems they create new problems because now the underworld takes notice of Jochen. The series premiered in ZDF in January 2016, the five parts will be shown on five consecutive evenings. The plans for the project were announced as "German 'Breaking Bad'".
title: Morgen hör ich auf

overview: Level seven government worker Jung Ha-na's dream is to retire peacefully, but her feisty attitude lands her in the Marriage Promotion Team at Injeong City Hall, a role she finds baffling as she doesn't believe in marriage herself. To make matters worse, her ex-boyfriend Ki-jun, whom she nearly married three years ago, appears as her new team leader, adding to her disbelief. Desperate to escape the team, Ha-na is tasked with marrying off local bachelor Cheol-hee. Though Cheol-hee initially refuses, believing he's not suited for marriage, Ha-na's determination gradually softens his heart. As they open up to each other, Ha-na and Cheol-hee, who both doubted their worthiness of marriage, find themselves questioning if they can take the plunge after all. Will Ha-na and Cheol-hee finally gather the courage to believe in love and marriage?
title: Marry You

overview: Follows Dept of Homeland Security officers at five different airports across the country, from San Francisco, Detroit, Newark, Atlanta, and Honolulu, as they search for contraband both leaving and coming into the US.
title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport

overview: See what happens when rage comes home, boiling over right on your front doorstep. Horrifying real stories of neighbors attacking each other after disagreements explode into violence. Shocking incidents of neighbors behaving badly, all caught on camera.
title: Residential Rage

overview: 90 Day: The Last Resort Between the Sheets is an unfiltered, one-hour after-show that dives deeper into each week's episodes. Cast members from this season of 90 Day: The Last Resort will provide behind-the-scenes commentary and personal reflections on their experiences at the resort. Through never-before-seen footage, and unique therapist interviews, viewers will get an exclusive insider look at what really went down when the cameras were and weren't rolling. This has all the juicy secrets, hilarious anecdotes and emotional moments as your favorite couples dissect jaw dropping scenes.
title: 90 Day: The Last Resort Between the Sheets

overview: A woman finds out her former lovers are dying in unusual ways and must go back through her sex timeline to confront her past in order to move forward – "Laid" is a f*cked up rom-com where the answer to "why can't I find love, is there something wrong with me?" is a resounding "Yes. There is. The problem is definitely you."
title: Laid

overview: This four-part documentary series is an inspiring coming-of-age story that follows teenagers from across America as they face off in the nation's premier civics competition. Culminating in a championship showdown in the nation's capital, high school students with diverse personal and political backgrounds grapple with critical questions about democracy.
title: Citizen Nation

overview: An explosive series offering unfiltered insights into America's most notorious killer, Charles Manson. Through 20 years' worth of never-before-aired conversations, those closest to the case have their views challenged as Manson talks openly about his part in the infamous crimes, as well as his upbringing, criminal youth and his true feelings about "The Family." Manson reveals the cruelty he suffered in reform school and the childhood experiences that made him who he was. Former "Family" members listen to the exclusive conversations and are taken back to the time when they "would do anything for Charlie." Manson recounts the early crimes that led to the murder spree in the summer of ‘69, laying out an explanation of loyalty and brotherhood that pushes against the accepted motive: his desire to incite Helter Skelter. In the final moments before his death, Manson reflects on his life in prison and shows rare tenderness for the man who spoke to him across the decades.
title: Making Manson

overview: To celebrate Halloween, LOL will be airing a surprise special edition of the show packed with unnaturally funny jokes! Michael Bully Herbig will be welcoming four eerie teams of two comprising Mirja Boes & Torsten Sträter, Palina Rojinski & Olaf Schubert, Annette Frier & Sasha, as well as Bill & Tom Kaulitz. Andthe rules are as follows: If somebody laughs, both members of the team are out!
title: LOL: Last One Laughing Germany - Halloween Special

overview: In Los Angeles in the 1980's, a killer terrorized South Central, murdering African American women and discarding their bodies in the street. Yet, as the victim count rose, there were few suspects leading to fear and anger in a community often overlooked by the LAPD. Eventually dubbed "The Grim Sleeper," this notorious killer went on to terrorize the neighborhood for decades until DNA technology allowed the LAPD to close in on the perpetrator. Featuring in depth interviews with survivors and victims' families, many speaking for the first time, as well as rare archival footage, "Cold Case Files: The Grim Sleeper" explores the personal stories of the victims who were all but forgotten by the police, the media and the community at large.
title: Cold Case Files: The Grim Sleeper

overview: As a rough guy, the idiosyncratic Tjark Wolf investigates in the rough landscape of East Frisia. At his side is the police chief Femke Folkmer, with whom he - of course - forms an unequal investigator duo. They make a grisly discovery on the North Sea coast - and little do they know that this will begin their collaboration in a series of murder cases that will push them to their limits - or even beyond.
title: Dünentod - Ein Nordsee-Krimi

overview: I Kissed a Girl promises to deliver all the romance, drama, and excitement that fans of the franchise have come to love. Set in an exotic location, the show follows a group of single queer women as they search for their perfect match, but with a twist: before any conversation, each girl is paired with their most compatible match, and their first interaction is a kiss. Will sparks fly, or will the chemistry fizzle out?
title: I Kissed a Girl

overview: Evil Escapes follows three disabled comedians as they take a spooky road trip across the UK and attempt to prank and out-scare each while exploring Britain's scariest and weirdest attractions.
title: Evil Escapes

overview: The history behind the most iconic games and how they went on to influence the world of pop culture and beyond will be explored in Game Changers, From Pong to Call of Duty and Monopoly to Minecraft,this eight-part limited series dives into the little-known backstories of how these wildly popular and successful games were created. Interviews with inventors, journalists, video game enthusiasts, authors and more reveal the brilliant inspiration and dirty deals that brought these games to the public.
title: Game Changers

overview: Criminal defense lawyer Friedrich Kronberg works within the German justice system to understand the misdeeds of his clients and defend them in court.
title: Schuld

overview: Tension, trauma and toxic relationships — and that's just the producers. Uncover the secrets of the salacious talk show, told by the people who made it.
title: Jerry Springer: Fights, Camera, Action

overview: On the occasion of the Day of Defenders of Ukraine, ICTV presents the first Ukrainian action series Sturm about the work of a special SBU unit that counteracts the most serious crimes against the national security of Ukraine.
title: Штурм

overview: A medical mystery thriller that traces the truth of the incident of a famous plastic surgeon, who had a reputation as a righteous man, who fell into the abyss after being caught up in an unexpected incident and underwent reconstructive plastic surgery for crime victims.
title: Face Me

overview: The show tells the story of Prosecutor Zhong Qinyang and Assistant Prosecutor Song Su, who uphold fairness and justice while handling a series of juvenile cases. Meanwhile, Zhong Qinyang befriends high school student Li Songyan and gradually uncovers the truth behind his parents' car accident. As the real culprit is brought to justice, everyone embarks on a new chapter of their lives under the warm light of justice.
title: Coming to Court Soon

overview: Mary shares her wit and wealth of cookery know-how with her celebrity pals, all keen to keep up in the kitchen. Success every time, in a joyful celebration of food with friends.
title: Mary's Foolproof Dinners

overview: On a fishing trip in the Canadian Rockies, schoolteacher Laura Letts-Beckett drowns under mysterious circumstances, leaving her husband, Peter, as the sole witness. What follows is so extraordinary that it's hard to believe this is a true story. A secret police investigation ensues, exposing additional murder allegations and questions about marriage, religion, suicide and a plot to kill witnesses.
title: In Cold Water: The Shelter Bay Mystery

overview: Hard North, following a diverse group of young Canadians as they embark on a challenging four-season mission: to build a life in the vast and unforgiving Canadian wilderness. The series takes viewers on an adventure through some of the country's most remote and rugged landscapes as these aspiring homesteaders face the harsh realities of living off the land and strive to not just survive - but to thrive in these wild places, they now call home.
title: Hard North

overview: "Einfach unzertrennlich" (Simply inseparable) was a Sketch - Comedy of German private television station VOX and the first self-produced series of the transmitter. The show was produced by Prime Productions. In various Sketches occur three different couples who show their solidarity in everyday situation. Aired the format was from the November 10, 2014 every workday from 19:45 clock, after it was announced at short notice and included in the program. The first season consists of 30 episodes, with a length of 15 minutes each. December 2014, gave VOX announced that the series will be made after 20 broadcast episodes from the program due to persistently poor ratings.
title: Einfach unzertrennlich

overview: Andrey, Kostya, Yura, Danya and Vitalik were best friends in the dashing 90s. The nickname Fingers quickly became attached to the teenagers, and the guys themselves were inspired by gangster romance. The lawlessness that reigned on the streets of the provincial Shubinskaya pushed them against local racketeers. The showdown resulted in death and criminal cases, and the gun was hidden in a hiding place. Only the Fingers knew about it, each of which went its own way. But 20 years later, the past catches up with the guys, and the trust between them collapses.
title: Пальцы

overview: In the new reality show "The Big Relocation", the village family of the Morozovs will challenge the most glamorous and large family of show business - the family of Dzhigan and Oksana Samoilova. The Morozovs will go to live in the luxurious Dzhigan mansion, and the Dzhigan family will go to the village "apartments" of the Morozovs. Will those who are used to a luxurious life be able to adapt to the countryside? And will those who have never seen luxury be able to survive in luxury conditions? TNT will swap the two families and check out what came of it.
title: Большое переселение

overview: One of the most famous cases in Italian true crime involves the disappearance of a girl named Sarah.
title: Qui non è Hollywood

overview: At Family Film And TV Awards, we honor the timeless stories that remind us of the importance of family, no matter what form it takes. From classic TV series to our current favorites, these programs celebrate the bonds that unite us.
title: Family Film And TV Awards

overview: Four celebrity friends take a girls trip to Vietnam to reinvigorate themselves, find new inspiration and celebrate a birthday. Nivea, Eva Marcille, Tammy Rivera and London Hughes travel through three regions of Vietnam, experiencing the culture and learning about one another. Along the way, cultural clashes and misunderstandings within the group lead to trouble early in the trip, and the ladies must figure out if they can get things back on track. The spirituality, hospitality and beauty of Vietnam help the ladies heal from heartache, strengthen friendships and reevaluate their priorities back at home.
title: Eat, Slay, Love

overview: A trucker, a crane operator, an orphanage pupil, a housewife from a Kyrgyz village, a mother with many children and others - they are united by talent and a desire to sing on stage. Due to life circumstances, they could not start their star trek, but in a vocal show they will try to fulfill their dream.
title: Царица

overview: In the all-new series Expedition Files, adventurer Josh Gates travels through history on a search to uncover new evidence and answers to the world's most captivating and unexplained mysteries. Each episode of Expedition Files explores compelling true stories that defy explanation, offering stunning revelations and surprising new insights.
title: Expedition Files

overview: "The Doctor by Vocation" is a Ukrainian series based on the story of Ohmatdyt's life during the first 50 days of the full-scale invasion. The series tells the story of a talented doctor who, amid a family crisis, decides to stay in Ukraine and work in a hospital during the war. Despite personal dramas and difficult conditions, she and her colleagues tirelessly save patients' lives.
title: Лікарка за покликанням

overview: Nikolas Heldt alias Kai Schumann is more human as an investigator and more normal as a human being than you would expect from a hero, let alone a superhero. He is a detective superintendent in Bochum, casual and sometimes quite cool. But he's not an alien with superpowers, he doesn't wear a mask or a full body costume in bright colors. The answer to the question, when someone is a hero, depends how often in life on the perspective.
title: Heldt

overview: For the first time ever, entertainment heavyweights Stefan Raab and Michael 'Bully' Herbig are competing as a duo on a game show. Who will come out on top? Their opponents could be tradesmen, doctors, students, teachers or lawyers. Raab and Bully will compete against the candidate who manages to beat three other contestants at the start of the show. Elton will host the new show, with Frank Buschmann providing commentary.
title: Stefan und Bully gegen irgendson Schnulli

overview: We live in a world of amazing and incredible phenomena that no one can explain. Secrets of nature, messengers from other worlds, mysterious animals and people with superpowers surround us in everyday life, and sometimes we don't even know about it. Our mission is to introduce you to them and teach you how to resist them. After all, there is only one way to protect yourself from them. It's laughter. Sincere and unstoppable.
title: Такое видео

overview: In this comedy-drama series, we are introduced to Braon Poitín. A curious but talented man, struggling to make his own way in the world, decides to bring his poitín business to the international market - whichever way he can. Braon believes he will be able to save the world with this miracle liquid and pushes the patience of his family and community to the end of their tether as he embarks on his questionable business through dubious marketing ideas.
title: An Poitín

overview: Reckless thrill-seeker Qin Lang has only one dream, become a narcotics officer, yet on graduation he's dumped into the Anti-Fraud Center. To transfer out faster, he's forced to partner with the icy, razor-sharp Gao Man, and the two become instant frenemies. Case by case, their crackdowns shatter fraud rings, and Qin starts to feel the pull of this new battlefield, until the day he discovers that the fraud syndicate's kingpin is inextricably linked to the drug lord he's sworn to take down.
title: Anti-Fraud

overview: After a kidnapping, jewelry heiress Wen Ruojun discovers that her husband, Gu Yancheng, not only cheated with her best friend but that their entire marriage was a carefully crafted scheme to seize her wealth. Awakening to the truth, Wen Ruojun finds Lin Jiayi, another of his victims, and the two women join forces with others to launch their revenge against Gu Yancheng!
title: The Fevengers

overview: A series of gruesome murders targeting young women sends Luoyang City into panic. Hu Zhengyi, a Dali Temple, is tasked with uncovering the truth. Meanwhile, rogue swordsman Li Jianxing deliberately approaches Hu to investigate his own family's massacre. From "Phoenix Murders" to "Puppet Brides," the duo navigates surreal cases, transforming from mutual suspicion to life-and-death allies in their pursuit of justice.
title: ShenDu Fox Detective

overview: Mi Youchu, a general's daughter, marries the heir Su Buxiao out of love, but suffer from betrayal and the destruction of her family. Reborn with revenge in her heart, she hones her skills to take down Su Buxiao—unaware that his body now hosts a game player trying to win her love. What begins as a deadly chase turns into a reluctant partnership when a mysterious figure threatens her family again. Forced to work together, they share laughs, survive danger, and slowly fall for each other, uncovering the truth—and love—along the way.
title: I Am Not Your Enemy

overview: "Freunde für immer - Das Leben ist rund" (Friends Forever - Life) is a TV series from Sönke Wortmann seven amateur football, for football the greatest thing has remained since the F-youth. Since childhood, the members of the football team kicking "Eleven Friends" together. Meanwhile, the recreational football are all over 30 and would certainly have long since lost sight of, if they do not lead the Sunday games in the "Bunte Liga" always together. For team include such diverse types as Axel, the gay lawyer, Heiko, the pot-smoking long-term student or the smart Mark, which is just Father. But when it comes against opponents as the "SV Fette Sau" or "Dynamo counter", they pull all together.
title: Freunde für immer - Das Leben ist rund

overview: To clear her late mother's name, the genius perfumer Ying Hemeng marries into her enemy's house, and becomes the concubine of the heir, Ye Buhuan. The two of them, each with their own agenda, have several confrontations and gradually develop feelings in the midst of their probing and scheming. Together, amidst a mixture of love and hatred, they unravel the truth of the past together.
title: Agarwood Like a Dream

overview: The life and legacy of Ted Turner is told in his own words in this six-part documentary series.
title: Call Me Ted

overview: Strike Back is a British/American action and military television series, based on a novel of the same name by novelist and former Special Air Service (SAS) soldier Chris Ryan. The series follows the actions of Section 20, a secretive branch of the British Defence Intelligence service (DI), who operate several high risk, priority missions throughout the globe.
title: Strike Back

overview: A group of adventurous VIP singles experience a summer full of exciting encounters and tingling flirts in a luxurious villa. Presenter Sylvie Meis leads the first VIP version of the successful dating show.
title: Love Island VIP

overview: Jinda, daughter of the lord of Lopburi, and excellent in appearance and intellect, was born to the highest of destinies. It is her great duty to seize the throne from Phra Chairacha, the warrior king of Ayodhaya, and return it to her own Lavo dynasty line. Jinda must therefore offer herself as one of four royal concubines, inevitably separating her from her lover Wamon. Her journey has her face the other three royal concubines of foreign origin, Jittrawadi, La-ongkham, and Tanyong, each vying for the position of queen consort.
title: The Empress of Ayodhaya

overview: USSR, 1970s. The world's first mystical hospital opens its doors to the demonically possessed. Doctor Yana heads the clinic to return her son, who was kidnapped by otherworldly forces.
title: 13 Клиническая. Начало

overview: It's in the Game: Madden NFL reveals the never-been-told story of Madden NFL, from its archaic 8-bit origins to its success as an annual must have—against all odds. For the first time ever, EA SPORTS is opening their vault of rare and never-been-seen footage, while also allowing cameras to follow along as the team finishes the next generation of the game. What started as an unlikely pairing between a computer whiz and a football legend, ignited a revolution and triggered a seismic collision between the worlds of jocks and geeks. They should have failed. Instead, their game changed the game—and our culture, too.
title: It's in the Game: Madden NFL

overview: Joanne Cantwell and Marty Morrissey presents live coverage from the RDS of the PwC All Star Awards 2024.
title: PwC All Stars Awards

overview: Live results coverage of the US presidential election, presented by Miriam O'Callaghan in Washington and David McCullagh in Dublin.
title: US Presidential Election Special

overview: Investigating the lives and characters of the US presidential and vice presidential candidates as they seek office. In an historic election, those who know the candidates best reveal key moments that shape how they would lead America.
title: The Choice 2024

overview: The Groomsmen follows Danny, Jackson, and Pete as they stand by each other through the biggest days of their lives. The narrative explores their complex relationships with friends, love interests, and family members, all while celebrating the bond of their enduring friendship. The Groomsmen trilogy offers a unique perspective on these significant life events, making it a must-watch for fans.
title: The Groomsmen

overview: Following revelations of a secret government program studying UFOs, many experts have stopped asking whether UFOs are real and have started wondering: "what are they?" The answer could change everything we thought we knew about human consciousness.
title: Beyond: UFOs and the Unknown

overview: Do movies help you to heal? To grow? To connect? Licensed therapist Jonathan Decker and professional filmmaker Alan Seawright draw from their experiences on the job to explore the psychology of your favorite films! Your "Internet Dads" combine humor, heart, and vulnerability to share healthy relationship skills, mental health awareness, and movie-making magic.
title: Cinema Therapy

overview: Showcases the heritage and diversity of French cuisine through a friendly and inventive exchange between cuisine from our regions and cuisine open to influences from around the world, led by chef Mory Sacko.
title: Cuisine Ouverte

overview: Paranormal investigator Alberto del Arco explores the sites of Mexico's most haunting crimes and tragedies.
title: Señales Del Más Allá

overview: Three friends inhabit an almost desert planet, whose only forest is locked behind a wall, built by the masters of the galaxy: the Majestic. But the three heroes find a secret passage that leads to the forest, and discover that the Majesties have a secret base there! What are they looking for? And who is this strange creature in the forest?
title: Makinium

overview: Despite initial misunderstandings and reservations from their families, Wichai and Anong find comfort in each other's company. Anong is a high-society lady whom many men compete for, given her status, it's important that her family finds her a good match. Passionate lawyer Wichai finds himself randomly tasked with screening potential husbands for her. His duty is to eliminate unsuitable candidates and pave the way for his younger brother. However, Wichai redefines what it means to be worthy, leading Anong to realize that no one is more suitable than Wichai himself. He only sees her, however, as a sister-in-law. Anong attempts to win his heart, even if there's only a "one in a hundred" chance that a confident woman such as she could land a saint like him. ~~ Adapted from the novel "Nueng Nai Roi" (หนึ่งในร้อย) by Dok Mai Sod (ดอกไม้สด).
title: One in a Hundred

overview: Here's Your Fridge is based on Taylor visiting some of the country's most popular figures in their homes, where together they take on the task of cooking a three-course meal using only the ingredients already in the fridge. Although the concept rests on the cooking arrangement, it is a program that is at least as much about Taylor as the viewers getting to know the celebrities in a new way.
title: Här är ditt kylskåp

overview: The drama series follows a group of teenage friends whose lives are impacted by the real-life fire that erupted at the República Cromañón club in Buenos Aires in 2004. The story is told from the perspective of Malena, a 19-year-old aspiring musician. On the night of the fire, Malena attends her favorite rock band's concert with her friends, unaware she will lose many of her loved ones at that event. Four years later, she returns to her childhood neighborhood to reconcile with her past and overcome the guilt she feels about surviving the tragic fire.
title: Cromañón: La noche del incendio

overview: "Soapstar - Eine Luftpumpe will nach oben" (Soap Star - An air pump will upwards), is about a more or less talented man who feels called to greater things. BERLINA TV dropouts makes the net autonomously: Steffen Donsbach (30), seen until recently in the RTL II-daily soap "Köln 50667", has now turned his own web series for the Munich-based commercial broadcaster such as RTL II announced on Monday. Born in Bielefeld plays in the twelve-part production entitled "Soap Star - An air pump will up" a man who feels a higher calling, in his opinion, has more fans than Jesus and at every moment waiting for the call from Hollywood, as it said. His motto: "If you have not succeeded at RTL II, then you can make it anywhere!". The series "Soap Star" with its eight to ten minutes long episodes is loud RTL II now www.rtl2.de on Youtube in its own channel and on the portals and www.rtl2now.de available.
title: Soapstar - Eine Luftpumpe will nach oben
